subject.title: All .large bubbles should have scrollable body regardless of truncation

question: Should native chat make every large/tall bubble body independently scrollable, or preserve direct transcript scrolling until content exceeds a defined bounded height?
rationale: The request is a deliberate mobile interaction-policy change with nested-scroll, accessibility, and cross-platform parity consequences; source inspection does not establish an existing product contract that selects one behavior.

options.title: Adopt bounded inner scrolling
options.body: Define a shared iOS/Android height rule and make qualifying large or tall bubble bodies scroll independently, with real-device interaction proof.

options.title: Keep transcript-only scrolling
options.body: Retain the current single-scroll-surface model and close this request only if maintainers decide consistent direct reading is preferable.

options.title: Use truncation-driven scrolling
options.body: Keep inner scrolling only after a clearly documented truncation or height threshold, rather than applying it to every large bubble.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded inner scrolling
recommendation.body: Define a shared iOS/Android height rule and make qualifying large or tall bubble bodies scroll independently, with real-device interaction proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior issue review already identifies the remaining question as a maintainer product decision for this native chat behavior.
